teleporter/32614.htm.text: Gatekeeper Lamcedas: This is the pier for Gludio Airships. Airships headed for the continent of Gracia also arrive and depart from here. We tap into a strong aura of power and depend on favorable winds to allow the Airships to travel such a far distance. If you're not ready to leave for Gracia yet,…
